_note: HAND-AUTHORED STAND-INS, NOT RECORDED MODEL OUTPUT. Written to make Stage 1's gate runnable and demonstrable without an API key. Confidence values are what a careful reader would assign to these voice notes, chosen so the gate is exercised in both directions. Re-record with `npm run milestone-b -- --live` once a key is set, and replace this file with the real output before claiming these numbers came from the model.

saree_blue.name: Blue Cotton Saree
saree_blue.notes: Price and stock both stated plainly — '1200 ka hai' and 'ek hi piece bacha hai'. Material and colour stated.

kurta_white.name: White Cotton Kurta
kurta_white.notes: Price stated twice and agrees with the Payment Page description. Size and count both stated.

bedsheet_double.name: Printed Double Bedsheet
bedsheet_double.notes: Merchant explicitly has not set a price — 'rate abhi fix nahi kiya hai'. Stock is a guess he hedged twice ('do teen', 'shayad'), so the count is not usable.

dupatta_silk.name: Maroon Silk Dupatta
dupatta_silk.notes: Price stated plainly. Stock is explicitly unknown — merchant has to check the godown — so no count was invented.

towel_set.name: Cotton Towel Set (3 pieces)
towel_set.notes: Price is per set and stated as such. Ten sets stated. Piece count is part of the product, not the stock count — kept as an attribute.
